root_motivation: Who: the autonomous agent holding only a tenant key, whose user said 'list my open GitHub issues'; the user, who should click one link. What: connect a provider at tenant level with the host's own OAuth app. Why not today: vault connect_link needs end_user self and a tenant-registered OAuth app, so prod held zero vault_tokens rows.
user_persona: An agent that calls host.connect.start, hands the returned url to its user, and polls host.connect.list until the provider shows connected; Operator Joe who sets MCPHOST_CONNECT_<PROVIDER>_CLIENT_ID/_SECRET on the host.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given a fresh implicit-signup tenant with no end user and no vault_providers row, When host.connect.start {provider: testprov} is followed through the test OAuth server and the callback runs, Then host.connect.list shows testprov connected with the default scope and vault_tokens holds one row with end_user_subject tenant and a non-null refresh_enc.

Given github with MCPHOST_CONNECT_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID unset, When host.connect.start {provider: github} runs, Then the error is provider_unavailable {provider, reason: client_id_not_configured} and no handoff row is written.
Given host.connect.start {provider: testprov, scopes: [bogus]}, When it runs, Then the error is scope_unknown {unknown: [bogus]}.

Given a redeemed handoff token, When /connections/go/<token> is opened again, Then it returns 410 and no second authorization starts; When the callback is called with that state, Then it returns 400 state_invalid.
Given the test server redirects with ?error=access_denied, When the callback runs, Then the page names access_denied, the handoff is used, and vault_tokens has no row.
Given a connected testprov, When host.connect.revoke runs twice, Then both calls succeed, the row has revoked_reason tenant_revoke, and host.connect.list carries a reconnect_url.
Given two concurrent host.connect.start calls for the same provider, When both callbacks complete, Then exactly one vault_tokens row exists and it holds the tokens of the later callback.
Given prod after this lands, When the callback is hit with a bogus state, Then it answers 400 and the body names state_invalid (Live; deferred, operator-provisioned).
acceptance_criteria.test: deferred -- operator-provisioned: live curl of prod's /connections/callback/github with a bogus state after deploy.

scope: src/connect/flow.rs: host.connect.start/list/revoke and the GET /connections/go/{token} and /connections/callback/{provider} routes.
ConnectProviders carries the host-owned client credentials (never printed); vault_tokens rows use end_user_subject 'tenant' and vault_handoff_tokens the same single-use PKCE handoff as the vault.
providers.toml gains an optional revoke_url; tests/common/testoauth.rs is the in-repo test OAuth server behind testprov.
non_goals: Using the stored token in a tool; scope enforcement at publish; audit rows; changing the end-user vault path.

additional.no_schema_change: The handoff row's oauth_state column carries '<random>:<scopes>' and a 'used:' prefix once the callback consumed it; vault_tokens' UNIQUE key admits the 'tenant' subject.

five_whys_trace.q: Why can an agent with only a tenant key not connect GitHub?
five_whys_trace.a: connect_link requires a verified end user and a tenant-registered OAuth app.
The vault was built for end-user tokens with the tenant's own client credentials.

five_whys_trace.q: Why does a tenant-level subject fix it?
five_whys_trace.a: A sentinel subject plus the host's own client ids needs neither an end user nor an app.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Is the OAuth state the handoff token itself?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: Yes (PRD R2); the callback looks the row up by its hash, requires /connections/go to have redeemed it, and marks it used with an oauth_state prefix, so no new column.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Why is the provider argument not a schema enum?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: The committed contract is the prod one while a test-support build also accepts testprov; Provider::parse is the same registry and answers invalid_params listing the names.
